targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (service) (label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~".+"}[2m]), "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)")) / sum by (service) (label_replace(container_spec_cpu_quota{container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~".+"} / container_spec_cpu_period{container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~".+"}, "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)") > 0)) > 40) or vector(0)

count((100 * sum by (service) (label_replace(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~".+"}, "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)")) / sum by (service) (label_replace(container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{container_label_com_docker_compose_service=~".+"}, "service", "$1", "container_label_com_docker_compose_service", "(.+)") > 0)) > 40) or vector(0)
